title: The Subtle Knife
author: Philip Pullman
summary: A boy hiding from the law in our world crosses into a strange abandoned city, where he meets Lyra. Together they come to guard a blade that can cut openings between worlds.
readIf: you have read The Golden Compass and want the story to widen into other universes.
skipIf: you want to start the series here; it assumes everything from the first book.

pairings.reason: The finale, which carries these ideas to a much grander and emotional conclusion.
Another thoughtful fantasy about power, balance and the cost of using magic.
A much lighter and funnier fantasy with an equally quick pace and young heroes.
